author: Deborah Brown
title: Happy birthday to Wellesley's own Katharine Lee Bates - NewsBreak
text:
By Deborah Brown ,
15 hours ago Happy birthday to 1874 Wellesley High School graduate and Bates Elementary School namesake Katharine Lee Bates, widely known as the author of the patriotic song America the Beautiful. In honor of the prolific writer, born on Aug. 12, who taught at Dana Hall School before landing a job as a professor of English literature at Wellesley College, I took a spin on the Shining Sea Bikeway. The 11-mile paved and level bike path stretches from Bates’ birthplace of Falmouth, to Woods Hole. Read full article
